 The Lukka Derivatives Data (“LDRD”) product is a comprehensive security master for derivatives contracts on digital assets. LDRD is designed to fulfill the global digital asset community’s need for an institutional-grade, clean, reliable, comprehensive, enriched, standardized and normalized data source for derivatives on digital assets. The dataset also includes a standardized derivative naming convention across trading venues.
